reconcile.note: The Geneva annotators read John's denial as answering the delegation's own notion of Elijah, not the sense in which Christ affirms it.

sides.snippet: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.
sides.verseText: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.

sides.snippet: They asked him, \"What then? Are you Elijah?\" He said, \"I am not.\" \"Are you the Prophet?\" He answered, \"No.\"
sides.verseText: They asked him, \"What then? Are you Elijah?\" He said, \"I am not.\" \"Are you the Prophet?\" He answered, \"No.\"
